collection.description: A respected elder insists that a traditional rule should never change, while younger villagers see a practical problem.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (elder), a respected elder, insists that a traditional rule should never change, while younger villagers see a practical problem.

choices.label: Ask the Elder Why the Rule Began
Run a Limited Trial of the Alternative

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: They reveal a forgotten safety concern worth preserving.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: They cannot recall the reason and agree that tradition alone may not settle the question.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The new approach works, and (elder) revises their view.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The trial reveals an unexpected drawback, strengthening part of (elder)'s concern.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: (child) identifies who is inconvenienced most by the rule.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (adult) proposes a compromise that preserves the tradition's purpose.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (young), a younger villager, apologizes for mocking (elder) while maintaining their position.
